## Purpose

Describe the problem this pull request solves and the intended outcome.

## Scope

List the exact files, workflows, or contracts changed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, or private product data were added
- [ ] Cursor Rules or Skills include clear scope and approval boundaries
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior changed
- [ ] The change was tested on a safe local or disposable environment where applicable

## Evidence

Provide relevant command output, screenshots, browser results, or links. Redact all secrets.

## Risk

Describe failure modes, permissions, external services, migrations, production impact, and rollback path.

## Approval boundary

State whether this change requires founder approval, production access, paid-service access, database writes, or publication approval.
